name: Bitwise OR Edge Sum
description: Replaced the explicit vertex-based algebraic equation with a global sum of bitwise ORs evaluated over all edges. Since the valid modes are 1 and 2, their bitwise OR is at most 3, and it achieves 3 if and only if the modes are different. Requiring the sum over m edges to be exactly 3m forces every edge to have distinct modes, perfectly preserving the bipartiteness constraint while completely removing the local algebraic affordance that models were pattern-matching.
